Title: Important Notice: Azure Product Retirement: End of Life Announcement of Azure Maps Creator Feature State Service Versions 31 March 2025

Body.Content:
Azure Maps Feature State Services will be retired on March 31, 2025.
 

You can continue to use Feature State Service APIs without interruption until March 31, 2025. On March 31, 2025 all Azure Maps Creator Feature State APIs will no longer be available. Any Feature State configurations created will be deleted and client applications will no longer receive Feature State updates.  

Required action    

To avoid service disruptions, please discontinue use of the Feature State services by March 31, 2025. You can move your applications to use Azure Maps Creator Custom Styling if you would like to continue to use real-time feature styling currently provided through Azure Maps Creator Feature State Services.  

To learn more about using Azure Maps Creator Custom Styling for real-time feature styling , see Enhance your indoor maps with real-time map feature styling 

 

Help and support     

 

If you have questions, get answers from community experts Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request.
